When Steve Brace, Dave Long and Paul Davies-Hale were preselected for the Olympic Marathon many were disappointed that a place on the team had not been left open for anyone making a good showing in the forthcoming London Marathon, previously used as a selection race for such events, writes ALAN MEAD.
After the race our man admitted to feeling pleased that he is now getting into good shape. 1, P.Davies-Hale (C&S) 28:37; 2, J.Kibor (Kenya) 28:37; 3, G.Staines (Belgrave) 28:42.
